scope.flow: bidTree non-competitive order removal when price levels reach maxNumLimitsPerSide
scope.environment: order book contract with bidTree and immutable maxNumLimitsPerSide

statements.text: maxNumLimitsPerSide is an immutable value equal to 2.
The bid side has two distinct price levels, 1e18 and 1e18 + 1e15, with 1e18 being the worst price.
Add 10 more orders at the existing worst price level 1e18.
Place a new order at a new price of 1e18 + 2e15, triggering the removal logic.

Removal of non-competitive orders is only performed when the bidTree size is exactly equal to maxNumLimitsPerSide, so once the number of price levels exceeds the limit the removal logic is no longer triggered.
The bidTree should be prevented from growing without bound; non-competitive order removal should keep the number of distinct price levels within maxNumLimitsPerSide.
When the price-level limit is reached, the least competitive (worst-price) orders should be removed so the book does not retain more than maxNumLimitsPerSide distinct price levels.
the bidTree from growing without bound

ambiguities: Report does not state who may call the order-placement functions or any authorization condition.
Report does not explicitly state the resulting price-level count as a separate impact outcome; only the mechanism is described.
Whether the 10 orders at 1e18 are added before or as part of the same transaction sequence is not specified beyond ordering.
The fragments state that the intended purpose of preventing unbounded bidTree growth is not achieved, but no distinct harmful outcome beyond that is expressly stated.
